title: The photograph with Clarence Williams, Piron and Benton
summary: A group photo from when the district closed, the failed Orpheum circuit plan, and Tom Benton and Clarence Williams's roles.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I was going to ask about this picture over here that you showed us the other day. With this group with Pierone and Benton and St. Cyr. I have a copy of this picture. But you said they were going to go on the road for some reason.

This was when the district first closed. And Clarence Williams, he was the man he was here then. And we had those pictures made to play on the Orphan Circa. By some means Pierone and Williams didn't agree. And Clarence Williams went off and left us there. But Pierone was the cause. We didn't get this job. We would have been the first colored band. See, you know what I said. That was 40 years ago. See. Alarm for Dixie. Then.
Before the original Dixie Land left here.
Do you remember about what year was it? During the First World War or after it or about when? What year that would be? The war started in 1914. That was after the...

The war in Germany started in Europe in 1914. And we got into it about 1917 or so. Or 18. 17, 17. Ended in 18. But we were playing at the 101 Ranch at that time. That was around 1914. But this picture had been made. See. This picture was made before that.
It was made by 1914 then. Before that. Before 1914. It was made.
See. See. That ought to be about 40 years. That ought to be before.
Oh yes. A long time ago. I was going to ask about Tom Benton. Let's see. He has a... He has a mandolin banjo there. What did he usually play? Did he play guitar, banjo, mandolin or what?
Tom Benton played the... Tom Benton played the... Played... And he was a good ragtime piano player.
Watch. I heard he was piano player.
And a... Pretty good singer. A very good bad band man. He was. And there's him and Johnny there together. So he was very good for the Tom Benton.
What was Clarence Williams doing in this group? Did he sing or play piano some time? Well...
He sang some time. He played piano some time. But I guess he's just going to be general booking agent. Whatever you might call it.
For the booking agent. For the group. For the group, really.
